description: An eight-step sequencer laid out in a circle, always quantized, with a chain of up to four scales and a separate slower track for a bass line

params.text: Sets the note for that step, quantized into the scale in play and spread over the octaves set by RANGE
Sets the root note of the scales, C through B
Sets how many octaves the step knobs are spread over, 1 to 4
Sets the gate length as a fraction of the step, and of one bar for the sub track's gate; a short gap is always left at the end so envelopes retrigger
Sets which of the eight steps the sub track takes its note from, for the scale slot chosen by SCALE
Chooses the scale held in that slot: Minor, Dorian, Phrygian, Minor pentatonic, Harmonic minor, Major, Fifths or Octaves
Sets how many bars the chain stays on each scale before moving on, 1 to 8
Chooses which scale slot's sub source step the STEP knob edits; each slot keeps its own
Sets how many bars pass between one sub note and the next, 1 to 8
Sets which of the sixteen grid positions in the bar a sub note starts on
Takes that scale slot in or out of the chain; the last slot left in cannot be taken out
Chooses the step order: Forward, Reverse, Pendulum, Drunk or Random
Sets how often the sequence advances: on quarter, eighth, sixteenth or thirty-second notes
Writes a fresh set of eight step notes; the new notes take over after the sequence has finished a full eight-step cycle
Turns that step into a rest: the sequence moves through it as usual, but no trigger or gate comes out

inputs.text: The clock the whole module runs from, one pulse per quarter note unless the menu says otherwise
A rising edge puts the sequence back to the beginning, back to the first enabled scale, and clears the measured tempo
Transposes both pitch outputs, rounded to the nearest semitone
Offsets that step's knob, 10V covering the knob's full travel; the voltage is read at the moment the step comes round
While patched it replaces the FLOW knob: 2.5V per position across the five orders
A rising edge moves the chain on to the next enabled scale slot and restarts its bar count
A rising edge writes a fresh set of eight step notes, taking over after a full eight-step cycle

outputs.text: The pitch of the current step, quantized and transposed
A 10V pulse 1ms long on each step that is not a rest
A 10V gate on each step that is not a rest, its length set by the GATE knob
A 10V gate on steps 1 and 5, for as long as that step's gate lasts
The sub track's pitch: the note of its source step, two octaves down, held for the whole sub note
A 10V gate at the start of each sub note, its length set by the GATE knob against one bar

notes: nothing moves until a clock arrives at CLOCK, and two pulses are needed before the tempo is known. If the clock stops for longer than one and a half pulses, every output is cleared
the accent output is fixed to steps 1 and 5 and cannot be set per step
each scale slot holds its own sub source step. Pick the slot with SCALE first, then set STEP; turning SCALE moves the STEP knob to that slot's stored value
menu: Clock input rate: 1 PPQN (Submit standard), 4 PPQN (compatibility) — sets how many pulses at CLOCK make one quarter note
Dice character: Subtle, Musical, Wild — sets how far DICE moves the notes: Subtle nudges by a degree, Musical anchors steps 1 and 5 and walks in small moves, Wild anchors and leaps
